9. Profile 
Applicants (can be either an entity or person/s) must meet the following requirements: 
Education/Degree 
Required: Knowledge in Evaluation of International Programs 
Desirable: Knowledge in International Relations, Th ird sector, European Union programs 
and/or Volunteering programs 
Professional experience 
Required: Minimum 3-5 years of experience in simila r works within the Third sector, prior 
experience in designing and leading evaluations, process management skills 
Desirable: Knowledge of projects funded by the European Union 
Other requirements 
 Language proficiency: Fluency in English 
 Up to date knowledge of familiarity of best practic e with regards to Volunteer 
management, from a European perspective 
 Motivation in Humanitarian Aid and/or International Volunteering programs 
 A proven ability to work collaboratively and constr uctively on a complex Consortium 
project involving different stakeholders 
 Previous experience in Capacity building of local partners 
 Excellent writing and communication skills  
 Innovation: Ability to work in a dynamic and creative way 
 Flexibility to adapt to changing requirements 
 Excellent interpersonal communication skills 
 
10. Selection process 
Consortium Coordinator MdM EU Aid Volunteers, in coordination with the Evaluation Unit of 
MdM-Spain: 
 Publication of the Terms of Reference in the countr ies of the MdM Consortium team 
(Spain, Sweden, Netherlands, Belgium and UK) 
 Deadline for the reception of tenders: the 22th  of November 2019 
 Pre-selection of the 3 best tenders 
 Validation by the Procurement Committee 
 
 


--- Page 8 ---

 
8 
 
 
11. Conditions  
Contract of external consultancy of entity and/or person/s 
 Budget: maximum 10.000 € (VAT included) 
 Deliverables defined (see point 8) 
 Approx. 2 months 
 Schedule of payments: 50% upon the signing of the c onsultancy contract/25% at mid-
term contract period/25% balance payment at the end of the contract + delivery of the 
final products 
 
12. How to apply 
Applicants should submit in ENGLISH  their technical proposal, detailed budget, schedul e, 
motivation letter, track record of the entity and C Vs of the Evaluator/s to 
ramon.esteso@medicosdelmundo.org  and evaluacion@medicosdelmundo.org  by 22/11/2019. 
 
 
Note:   
Please note that only shortlisted applicants will be contacted for an interview.  
MdM is committed to diversity and inclusion within its workforce and encourages qualified 
female and male candidates from all national, relig ious and ethnic backgrounds, including 
persons living with disabilities, to apply to become a part of our organization.
